editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally, with correct terms and the informal "tu" throughout. For example, "rilevamento di errori quantistici a basso overhead", "valore atteso", "canali di rumore appresi negli osservabili tramite la propagazione di Pauli" and "delimitare più strettamente la sensibilità agli errori" all keep the English meaning.

Nothing here would mislead a learner. The pre-flight checks, the TEM-vs-PEC shot comparison and the circuit/application function descriptions all keep their meaning, and the "tu" register holds throughout. Three small things a native editor would still fix. In [41], "eseguire, eseguire il debug e analizzare" repeats "eseguire" awkwardly. In [70], "del QPU" uses the masculine, but Italian usually treats QPU as feminine ("della QPU", from "unità"). The plan name also changes form: "piano IBM Quantum Premium" / "piani Premium e Flex" in [61]/[30], but "Premium Plan" left in English in [62]/[65].

editor_note: Faithful and natural across all five entries; "skill Qiskit" is used consistently, and "È stata rilasciata la skill ... per la migrazione del codice qiskit-ibm-runtime" keeps the source meaning exactly.

The Italian is faithful and reads naturally, and it keeps the English source's hedge in [9] ("strumenti all'avanguardia che potrebbero essere più veloci"). Terminology is consistent ("transpilazione", "passaggi di transpilazione basati sull'IA"), and the imperatives use the informal "tu" form ("Consulta", "visita", "Leggi").

The translation is faithful and reads naturally, with informal "tu" throughout ("Scrivi pass del transpiler personalizzati", "Ti chiedi cosa è cambiato?", "Visita il blog"), correct terms ("misurazione proiettiva congiunta", "transpilazione early fault-tolerant", "fedeltà") and no meaning drift.

I found no misleading meaning drift. Dates, retirement timing ("intorno al", "non prima del"), numbers and the deprecation lists all match the English, and the tu register holds. Several month headings were left in English ("July 2026", "May 2026", "April 2026", "March 2026", "February 2026", "January 2026") while "Settembre 2026" and "Agosto 2026" are translated, and the heading "Qiskit Runtime rename" is untranslated. QPU switches gender between "la QPU" (2026 entries) and "il/un QPU" (older entries). UI labels are also inconsistent: "Compute resources" vs "Risorse di calcolo", and "Instance access" vs "Accesso all'istanza". [218] has a gender error: "i batch session" should be "le sessioni batch".
